IF
UseStarted(_Char,S_DEN_TunnelFrontIn_d03fc0d8-2f7f-4b5e-9e5c-674358ba3d7a)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("DEN_TunnelFrontReveal")
THEN
SetEntityEvent(S_DEN_TunnelFrontOut_0dbc8db6-0808-49a8-a715-20323e48f44a,"StoryReveal");

IF
FlagSet(PLA_ZhentShipment_State_SurvivorsAreDead_bb54af09-b0c2-46c2-84e8-642280ccec6a, _, _)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_PLA_ZhentShipment_CargoVBBlocked(1)
AND
GetFlag(PLA_ZhentShipment_State_HasShipment_73c09128-cbf6-441a-a882-96a891eee90f, _Player, 1)
AND
IsOpened(S_PLA_ZhentShipment_Chest_fc3f4359-ec62-4cbf-8756-ecb9780c34e8, 0)
THEN
PROC_PLA_ZhentShipment_PlayCargoVB(_Player);

IF
UseStarted(_Player, S_CRE_DaisyCaveEntrance_446c526d-d3a0-4b22-b0b7-93713b467ff2)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_Companion)
AND
NOT DB_Avatars(_Companion)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsAvailableAndInDialogRange(_Player, _Companion)
THEN
SetFlag(CRE_AstralPrison_State_CompanionPresent_4e173d11-1589-4394-acd2-c80b67fe7382);
